(#{item.id},#{item.code},#{item.supplierId},#{item.porkReportId},#{item.porkReportCode},#{item.standardWeight},#{item.weightCompliant},#{item.goodsCategoryId},#{item.goodsCategoryName},#{item.freshLabel},#{item.label},#{item.footMarkCode},#{item.weight}, #{item.price},#{item.place},#{item.terminalNumber},#{item.porkArrangeTime},#{item.passed},#{item.picPaths},#{item.transferNumber},#{item.transferFiles},#{item.transferStatus},#{item.tenant},#{item.createBy},#{item.createTime})
